import sys

def main():
    x, y, n = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())
    sn, sd = 10000000, 1
    for den in range(1, n + 1):
        ap = (x * den) / y
        num = int(ap)
        if ap - num > 0.5:
            num += 1
        if (y * den) * abs(x * sd - sn * y) > (y * sd) * abs(x * den - num * y):
            sn, sd = num, den
    print(f"{sn}/{sd}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
